_comment: THE BUNDLE CONTRACT. What another repo may rely on in dist/fx.js, dist/gui.js and dist/app.js: the window.* names each bundle must define when it is loaded ALONE (APK:OS loads them by path from OS/system/sound.modules.json: host = fx; mixer = React + fx + gui; midi = React + app), the plugin ids fx must register, and the API version each bundle announces as window.<apiGlobal>. Held by test/exports.test.mjs, which boots each built bundle in a fresh fake window and checks every name. `version` is package.json's and is a semver: removing or renaming a name below, or changing what it does, is a MAJOR bump; adding a name is a MINOR one. A consumer pins by reading window.OA_FX_API / OA_GUI_API / OA_APP_API (or this file) and refusing a different major. `consumes` is the other direction: what this repo's page takes from APK:OS, so that dependency is written down and tested too. Names here were measured against APK:OS on 2026-10-30 (Mixer/dsp/*, Midi/pads, Midi/sequencer, Midi/site/agent).

consumes.APK:OS/Midi/site/agent/sound-agent.js: the OS sound watchdog; index.html loads it first, by the relative URL ../../../APK:OS/Midi/site/agent/sound-agent.js (relative on purpose: it resolves against wherever the portal mounts APK:Softapps beside APK:OS, which is the one layout the watchdog exists for; the OS frames this page on its sound site at that same path). It redefines window.oaBusUrl to the shell's port when framed; a 404 is silent and the page runs alone.
